title: 第六章 尸油蜡第七章 鬼为钱亡
content_zh:
“你死了。”
“死的稍微有一些价值。”
“隐秘的故事对你解开了一角，虽然没挖掘出任何侵蚀点，但你对剧情做出了一些推进，所以你将获得了一个白色临时天赋：破碎存在。”
“当你失去部分肢体的时候，会额外增加一定的移动速度，该效果无法叠加。”
——周游再次从那个未知空间苏醒的时候，脸色是有些难看的。
虽然他在几秒前刚体验了一回液压机下试验品的感觉，但由于死的太快，倒还没来得及体会到多少的痛感，所以比起死亡的惊恐，某种‘被坑了’的恼怒反而更多一些。
“不是，这特么是新手难度？这才不过4层楼的区域啊，直接来三个毫无征兆的即死？？？黑魂都没你这么离谱，仁王都比你有良心，老哥，有必要搞这种——”周游抬起头刚想抱怨两句，但在看到那漂浮纸页的一瞬间，他却不知为何皱起眉头，像是想起来什么一般，倏然停下了话语。
“——等等，不，不对，或许我应该这么想，或许正是因为新手难度才会搞这些即死方式？毕竟我现在无限复活币，它可能是想要通过这种方式让我熟悉一些什么.....”
只是没等他进一步思考，那冰冷的女声忽然又在他的耳边响起。
“由于玩家仍处于新手期，所以可以使用10点魂石，将自己死亡前后的十秒进行回放，请问是否回放？”
“你老这是找准时机特地来打断的吗.......算了，现在考虑那么多也没用，还是将精力集中到这个诡楼里，看看怎么跑路吧。”
不过周游也未再多说些什么，而是依旧选择了回放。
“扣除10点魂石，现在玩家保有的魂石数额为：10。”
和之前一样，录像一样的画面又再度自他眼前展开。
只不过这回不是俯视，而是纯粹的正面视角。
在画面中，他才刚刚迈开腿，此时正打算向着五楼走去，周围并也没有任何异常。
然而，就在他踏上第一个台阶的瞬间。
就在他的身后，本来空无一物的墙壁间，忽然无声无息地伸出了一双手。
那双手苍白，纤细，乍一看去除了长到不可思议以外并没什么其他问题，但只要仔细一观察，就能发现这双手所有的关节和骨骼都呈不自然的弯曲，就像是很多条胳臂被活生生砸碎又重新拼接上一般，只会让人感觉到某种毛骨悚然的怪异。
然后，就在下一刻，这双手突然像是察觉到了什么东西一般，骤然飞速向前伸长。

眨眼间，几米的距离转瞬即过。
在周游根本没有反应过来的时候，那双手就直接死死地抓住了他，而对联间的墙壁也随之一阵蠕动。就见那灰色的墙皮片片开裂，在混凝土之间，忽地露出了一个被切成两半的苍白人脸——只见这东西带着怪诞的笑容，活生生地分开了自己的身体，就像是一扇真正打开的门一般，欢欣鼓舞地将周游迎接进去——
最后，猛然合拢。
血液霎时飞溅，画面也随之陷入了一片黑暗。
“......你已发现一个关键侵蚀点。”
“你获得30点魂石奖励，现在玩家保有的魂石数额为：40。”
看着自己被活生生吃掉的画面，周游脸上依旧没什么变化，他在重复播放了几次死亡回放后，又仔细思考了一会，忽然做出了一个莫名其妙的举动。
——只见他慢悠悠地走到房间的另一边，稍微活动了下筋骨做了做热身运动，接着弯下身，用手撑着地面，接着......
猛然向前跑去。
房间的另一边转瞬即至——
有一说一，虽然身患绝症，但他以前身体素质还算不错，跑的速度也勉强可以。
content_en:
"You're dead."
"There's a little more value in dying."
"The secret story has unlocked a corner for you. Although you haven't unearthed any erosion points, you have made some advancements in the plot, so you will receive a white temporary talent: Broken Existence."
"When you lose part of your limbs, you will gain an additional movement speed. This effect cannot be superimposed."
——When Zhou You woke up from that unknown space again, his face was a little ugly.
Although he had just experienced the feeling of a test object under a hydraulic press a few seconds ago, because he died too quickly, he had not had time to feel much pain, so compared to the fear of death, he felt more annoyed at being "trapped".
"No, this is a novice difficulty? This is only a 4-story area, and three people are dying without warning??? Dark Souls are not as outrageous as you, Niou is more conscientious than you, brother, it is necessary to do this -" Zhou You raised his head and was about to complain, but the moment he saw the floating page, he frowned for some reason, as if he remembered something, and suddenly stopped talking.
"——Wait, no, that's not right, maybe I should think so, maybe it is because of the novice difficulty that these instant death methods are used? After all, I now have unlimited resurrection coins, it may be to make me familiar with something in this way..."
But before he could think further, the cold female voice suddenly sounded in his ears again.
"Since the player is still in the novice stage, he can use 10 soul stones to replay the ten seconds before and after his death. Do you want to replay it?"
"Did you find the right opportunity to interrupt me? ...Forget it, it's useless to think about it now. Let's just focus on this mysterious building and see how to escape."
However, Zhou You didn't say anything more and still chose to play back.
"Deducting 10 soul stone points, the amount of soul stones the player now has is: 10."
Just like before, the same scene as the video unfolded before his eyes again.
Only this time it's not a bird's eye view, but a purely frontal view.
In the picture, he had just opened his legs and was planning to walk towards the fifth floor. There was nothing unusual around him.
However, the moment he stepped onto the first step.
Just behind him, between the empty walls, a pair of hands suddenly stretched out silently.
The hands were pale and slender. At first glance, there was nothing wrong with them except that they were incredibly long. However, if you look closely, you will find that all the joints and bones of the hands are unnaturally curved, as if many arms were smashed alive and then rejoined, which only made people feel some kind of creepy weirdness.
Then, at the next moment, the hands suddenly stretched forward quickly as if they noticed something.
In the blink of an eye, the distance of several meters passed by in an instant.
When Zhou You didn't react at all, the hands grabbed him tightly, and the wall between the couplets also squirmed. The gray wall cracked, and between the concrete, a pale human face cut in half was suddenly revealed - with a weird smile, this thing separated its body alive, like a real open door, happily welcoming Zhou You in -
Finally, it closed suddenly.
Blood spattered instantly, and the scene fell into darkness.
"...You have discovered a critical erosion point."
"You received a 30-point soul stone reward. The amount of soul stones currently held by the player is: 40."
Looking at the scene of himself being eaten alive, Zhou You's face remained unchanged. After playing the death replay several times, he thought carefully for a while and suddenly made an inexplicable move.
——I only saw him walking slowlyHe walked to the other side of the room, stretched his muscles a little and did some warm-up exercises, then bent down and put his hands on the ground, and then...
Suddenly ran forward.
The other side of the room is here in an instant——
There is a saying that although he is terminally ill, his physical fitness was quite good before, and his running speed was barely adequate.
